**Enum** in the `Latiprimere` namespace, from the [Latiprimere.Abstractions](/docs/reference/#latiprimereabstractions) package.

```csharp
public enum PrintOptionKinds : long
```

The settings of [PrintOptions](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/printoptions/), as flags, for saying which of them a printer applies ([IPrinter.AppliedOptions](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/iprinter/#appliedoptions)).

A value is added for each setting a later version adds to [PrintOptions](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/printoptions/). A printer that doesn't list one is refused a job that sets it to anything but its default, with [NotSupportedException](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.notsupportedexception), rather than printing as if it weren't set. Treat a value you don't know as a setting you don't know. The flags are a `long`, so there is room for 64 settings.

## Values

- **`None`** (`0`): No settings.
- **`JobName`** (`1`): [PrintOptions.JobName](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/printoptions/#jobname).
- **`Copies`** (`2`): [PrintOptions.Copies](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/printoptions/#copies).
- **`Duplex`** (`4`): [PrintOptions.Duplex](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/printoptions/#duplex).
- **`Orientation`** (`8`): [PrintOptions.Orientation](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/printoptions/#orientation).
- **`MediaSize`** (`16`): [PrintOptions.MediaSize](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/printoptions/#mediasize).
- **`ColorMode`** (`32`): [PrintOptions.ColorMode](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/printoptions/#colormode).
- **`Scaling`** (`64`): [PrintOptions.Scaling](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/printoptions/#scaling).
- **`InputTray`** (`128`): [PrintOptions.InputTray](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/printoptions/#inputtray).
- **`VendorOptions`** (`256`): [PrintOptions.VendorOptions](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/printoptions/#vendoroptions).
- **`OutputFile`** (`512`): [PrintOptions.OutputFile](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/printoptions/#outputfile).
- **`PageRanges`** (`1024`): [PrintOptions.PageRanges](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/printoptions/#pageranges).
- **`Collate`** (`2048`): [PrintOptions.Collate](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/printoptions/#collate).
- **`Quality`** (`4096`): [PrintOptions.Quality](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/printoptions/#quality).
- **`Finishings`** (`8192`): [PrintOptions.Finishings](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/printoptions/#finishings).
- **`OutputBin`** (`16384`): [PrintOptions.OutputBin](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/printoptions/#outputbin).
- **`MediaType`** (`32768`): [PrintOptions.MediaType](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/printoptions/#mediatype).
